data.name: Notice.AuthorizedUseOnly
data.value: Use only on devices and accounts you own or have the owner's explicit permission to service. Bypassing the sign-in protection of someone else's device can be a criminal offence.

data.name: Hint.Rescue.OldImage
data.value: Older image with an old Linux kernel: newer hardware such as NVMe drives may not be recognised, and UEFI-only computers cannot start it.

data.name: Hint.Rescue.ResetBreaksEfs
data.value: Resetting the password of an account makes its EFS-encrypted files unreadable. Works for local accounts only.

data.name: Hint.Rescue.WindowsPeTerms
data.value: According to Microsoft, Windows PE may only be used for deployment and recovery, and it restarts after 72 hours of continuous use.

data.name: Hint.Rescue.SecureBootMayRefuse
data.value: The boot loader is not suitable for Secure Boot or is rejected by current revocation lists. Secure Boot may have to be switched off temporarily to use it.

data.name: Hint.Rescue.ThirdPartyCompilation
data.value: A compilation of third-party programs; each program is subject to its own licence terms.

data.name: Hint.Rescue.SignaturesOutdated
data.value: Virus signatures go out of date quickly. Update the signatures after booting, if a network connection is available.

data.name: Hint.Rescue.UpdatedInPlace
data.value: The vendor replaces the file under the same address on a regular basis, so there is no fixed checksum; integrity relies on the encrypted connection (HTTPS) only.

data.name: Pc.Intro
data.value: Checks hardware, firmware and Windows 11 requirements and suggests settings for the media. Nothing is sent or changed.

data.name: Step.Tiny.FetchSource
data.value: Copying the source ISO to the work area

data.name: Tiny.Intro
data.value: Builds a slimmed-down installation medium from an original Windows ISO. The original stays untouched; the result is a new ISO file that you then write to a stick on the Write page.

data.name: Tiny.NoWindows
data.value: This file does not contain a Windows install image.

data.name: Tiny.Options.Hint
data.value: A tick means: gets removed or switched off.

data.name: Tiny.Bypass.Hint
data.value: TPM 2.0, Secure Boot, memory and processor are not checked during setup. Microsoft does not support such installations.

data.name: Tiny.Fat32.Hint
data.value: Compresses in a way that lets the install image be split later. The ISO gets larger.

data.name: Tiny.Account.Hint
data.value: Name of an account that is created during setup without a Microsoft account. Leave empty for the normal setup.

data.name: Tiny.NoServicing
data.value: I understand that this image can no longer be updated afterwards.

data.name: Tiny.Space
data.value: The build needs about three times the size of the install image as free space on the system drive and takes 15 to 45 minutes depending on the machine.

data.name: Tiny.Profile.tiny11.Desc
data.value: Removes preinstalled apps, Edge, OneDrive and telemetry. Windows Update and Defender stay, the image stays serviceable.

data.name: Tiny.Profile.tiny11core.Desc
data.value: Additionally without the component store, recovery environment, Defender and language features. The image can no longer be updated afterwards, and neither features nor languages can be added.

data.name: Tiny.Profile.tiny10.Desc
data.value: Windows 10 22H2 without preinstalled apps, OneDrive and telemetry. The image stays serviceable, Edge stays installed by default.

data.name: Tiny.Group.consumer.Hint
data.value: Clipchamp, Weather, News, Maps, Solitaire, Tips and other store apps.

data.name: Tiny.Group.xbox.Hint
data.value: Xbox apps, game bar and gaming services.

data.name: Tiny.Group.office.Hint
data.value: Office hub, OneNote and Sticky Notes.

data.name: Tiny.Group.copilot.Hint
data.value: Copilot app and AI features in the taskbar.

data.name: Tiny.Group.teams.Hint
data.value: Teams (personal) and the chat icon in the taskbar.

data.name: Tiny.Group.outlook.Hint
data.value: New Outlook as well as Mail and Calendar.

data.name: Tiny.Group.phone.Hint
data.value: Connection to the phone and cross-device services.

data.name: Tiny.Group.media.Hint
data.value: Microsoft's media apps (Groove, Movies and TV).

data.name: Tiny.Group.oem.Hint
data.value: Dolby and Intel extras that Windows ships with.

data.name: Tiny.Group.tools.Hint
data.value: Paint, Camera, Sound Recorder and Quick Assist. Off by default.

data.name: Tiny.Group.edge.Hint
data.value: Removes Edge and its update service. Programs that need WebView2 will not run.

data.name: Tiny.Group.onedrive.Hint
data.value: Removes the OneDrive setup and switches syncing off.

data.name: Tiny.Group.telemetry.Hint
data.value: Switches off diagnostic data, scheduled telemetry tasks and feedback prompts.

data.name: Tiny.Group.sponsored.Hint
data.value: Stops Windows from installing sponsored apps and suggestions later.

data.name: Tiny.Group.bitlocker.Hint
data.value: Prevents automatic BitLocker encryption during setup.

data.name: Tiny.Group.oobe.Hint
data.value: Allows the first-run setup with a local account.

data.name: Tiny.Group.reserved-storage.Hint
data.value: Gives back the roughly 7 GB reserved for updates.

data.name: Tiny.Group.legacy-components.Hint
data.value: Internet Explorer, Media Player and other optional components.

data.name: Tiny.Group.language-features.Hint
data.value: Handwriting, OCR, speech recognition and text to speech.

data.name: Tiny.Group.defender.Hint
data.value: Removes the antivirus; the PC is unprotected until another product is installed.

data.name: Tiny.Group.windows-update.Hint
data.value: Switches Windows Update off after setup.

data.name: Tiny.Group.winsxs.Hint
data.value: Shrinks the component store drastically; there are no updates or added features afterwards.

data.name: Tiny.Group.winre.Hint
data.value: Empties winre.wim and saves about 500 MB; there is no Windows recovery afterwards.

data.name: Tiny.Group.search.Hint
data.value: Switches off Bing web search and Cortana.

data.name: Tiny.Group.news-and-interests.Hint
data.value: Switches off the taskbar widget and Meet Now.

data.name: Tiny.Group.game-bar.Hint
data.value: Switches off the Game Bar and Game DVR.

data.name: Disc.Intro
data.value: Burns images to discs, reads discs into ISO files and erases rewritable discs. When reading, unreadable sectors are retried and listed; copy-protected discs are refused.

data.name: Disc.Action.Rip
data.value: Read a disc into an ISO file

data.name: Disc.ReadBack
data.value: Read the disc back afterwards and compare it with the image (SHA-256)

data.name: Disc.Finalize
data.value: Finalize the disc (needed for boot and installation media)

data.name: Disc.Overwrite
data.value: Overwrite a rewritable disc that already holds data

data.name: Disc.Erase.Full
data.value: Full (overwrites the whole disc, takes as long as burning)

data.name: Disc.Confirm.Erase
data.value: The contents of the disc in {0} will be erased. This cannot be undone.

data.name: Disc.Confirm.Overwrite
data.value: The disc in {0} holds data that will be overwritten. This cannot be undone.

data.name: Step.Burn.HashSource
data.value: Reading the image and computing its checksum

data.name: Step.Burn.ReadBack
data.value: Reading the disc back and comparing

data.name: Tools.Intro
data.value: Checks sticks against their image and returns sticks to a clean state after a hybrid image.

data.name: Tools.Tool.Verify
data.value: Check a medium against its image

data.name: Tools.Verify.Hint
data.value: Reads the medium and compares it with the image. Nothing on the medium is changed.

data.name: Tools.Verify.Done
data.value: The medium matches the image ({0} compared).

data.name: Tools.Restore.Hint
data.value: Erases the partition tables and the start and end of the drive and creates one partition across the whole disk. All data is lost.

data.name: Profile.Copied
data.value: The command line was copied to the clipboard.

data.name: Profile.Prompt.Text
data.value: Name of the profile. If it matches one of your own profiles, that one is replaced.

data.name: Profile.Locks
data.value: The profile locks {0} setting(s); they are taken from the profile when writing.

data.name: Profile.TeamNoDelete
data.value: Team profiles cannot be deleted here.

data.name: Settings.TeamProfiles.Hint
data.value: Shared folder with the team's profiles, for example a network drive. The profiles appear on the Write page.

data.name: Settings.Diagnostics.Hint
data.value: Packs the latest logs and a description of the system into a ZIP file for support. No images, passwords or machine names are included.

data.name: Diagnose.Confirm.Text
data.value: Should the package also contain the logs of the administrator process? Windows asks for administrator rights for that.

data.name: Diagnose.DoneWithoutBroker
data.value: The diagnostics package was saved without the logs of the administrator process: {0}

data.name: Tools.Tool.Test
data.value: Test a stick (capacity and bad blocks)

data.name: Tools.Test.Hint
data.value: Writes test data over the whole stick and reads it back: finds sticks with a faked capacity and defective memory areas. All data on the stick is lost, and it has to be formatted again afterwards.

data.name: Tools.Test.Mode.Quick
data.value: Capacity and quick block test (two patterns)

data.name: Tools.Test.Mode.Thorough
data.value: Capacity and thorough block test (four patterns, can take hours)

data.name: Test.Verdict.Good
data.value: Good: the capacity is right and no bad blocks were found.

data.name: Test.Verdict.GoodCapacity
data.value: The capacity is right. Bad blocks were not tested.

data.name: Test.Verdict.Fake
data.value: Faked capacity: the stick claims {0} but only has about {1}.

data.name: Test.Verdict.FakeUnknown
data.value: Faked capacity: the stick claims {0} but does not keep everything that is written to it.

data.name: Test.Verdict.Bad
data.value: Bad blocks: {0} area(s) totalling {1} found. Better not use this stick for important data any more.

data.name: Test.AfterwardsFormat
data.value: The stick now holds test data and has no partition table. Use "Restore a drive" or the Write page to set it up again.

data.name: Sheet.Intro
data.value: Captures before a reinstall what is on this PC: programs, additional drivers and Wi-Fi networks, and on request Wi-Fi keys, BitLocker recovery keys and the Windows product key. The result is always saved encrypted; nothing leaves the machine.

data.name: Sheet.Opt.WlanKeys
data.value: Wi-Fi keys in clear text (needs administrator rights)

data.name: Sheet.Password.Text
data.value: The customer sheet holds confidential data and is encrypted. Choose a password of at least 8 characters; without it the sheet cannot be opened again.

data.name: Sheet.Password.Mismatch
data.value: The two passwords do not match.

data.name: Sheet.Password.Open
data.value: Password to open the customer sheet.

data.name: Sheet.Saved
data.value: The customer sheet was saved encrypted: {0}
